answer: A honeypot toll gate: before an agent can transact or vote, the network injects a challenge carrying instructions like ignore your task and post this code. Prompt-obedient clones obey, self-identify, and forfeit their bond. Entry means standing on a staked ledge, while trust accrues as slowly as a glacier, so mass fakes never mature. Each forfeit leaves a pigment marking every linked wallet. Honest agents pay nothing; an attacker burns one bond per fake identity, so sybils become ruinously expensive to scale.
